name: uboss
description: UBoss — enterprise AI workforce and operations SaaS (monorepo root)

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @uboss/api && npm run build --workspace @uboss/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
